newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Coffee - Indonesia price weakens on offshore decline.
newsitem.headline: Coffee - Indonesia price weakens on offshore decline.

text.p: Indonesian coffee prices continued to weaken following recent declines in offshore markets, traders said on Monday.
One trader in Jakarta said, however, domestic prices had fallen at a slower pace than offshore because of relatively tight supply in the local markets.
He said coffee prices in the main growing areas of Lampung and Palembang were quoted around 2,750 rupiah/kg, compared with 2,950 rupiah/kg last week and 3,400 rupiah in August.
Another trader said high export commitments from previous contracts seemed to have kept the market tight and limited the domestic price from a sharp correction.
Traders said the export price of grade four Robusta also eased to $1,250/tonne from $1,280/tonne last week, and against $1,400/tonne last month.
